notes.title: Version 3.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed Bug where player fall from ground
- Gun UI not in correct position. Now fixed.
- Added Thunder sounds for more immersive and scary feel.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed no response on Door inspection
- Adjusted item position for better visibility

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
1st Anniversary Update 

Changes
- Evil Officer now SPEAKS!!
   Evil Officer is more immersive than ever. Experience the horrors as he constantly calls you.
- More than 10 Different voice sentences depending on the situation
- Added better Feel to Gun and Shooting
- A New Ending Through Sewers!
- Improved Graphics
- Improved VFX
 

Fixes/Improvements
- Fixed the issues where game cause random lags.
- Fixed player going out of scene in Sewers Area.
- Evil Officer speed adjusted for each difficulty level.
- Fixed screen tearing issue.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Explore the Evil Officer's house with a Halloween theme. 

Halloween
- Halloween theme added for a Limited Time.
- Halloween Props i.e. Pumpkin, Skulls give an even more spooky vibe!
- Evil Officer getting a limited-time Halloween Pumpkinhead.

Improvements
- Settings not working bug fixed.
- Language bug fixed.

notes.title: Nightmare Mode Update
notes.notes:
Evil Officer Update 2.0.0 is now live. It includes the following major changes:

New Game Mode: Nightmare
- Explore the haunted house in a new mode
- Scarier and darker atmosphere only for daring players.
- More scarier background sounds and SFX

Gameplay Update
- Added more achievements.
- Several Bug fixes
- Fixes black color artifact on water tap
- Nightmare mode extended the total gameplay time

notes.title: Achievements Update (V1.1.0)
notes.notes:
What's new?
- Steam Achievements Added
- Progress for each difficulty level
- Difficulty level description
- More tips on the loading screen
- Game sound update. (Scarier than ever!)

Bug Fixes:
- Dropping items inside the helicopter makes them unreachable
- Evil Officer stuck on doors
- Evil Officer stun time on shot was the same on all difficulties.

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Subject: Important Update: New Release Date for Evil Officer

Hello Gamers,

Prepare to embrace the darkness and confront your deepest fears in Evil Officer. We appreciate your unwavering enthusiasm and anticipation for the spine-chilling experience we're crafting. Today, we're reaching out with a significant update regarding the game's release date.

In our relentless pursuit of delivering a truly terrifying and immersive horror adventure, we've made the decision to extend the release date of Evil Officer. This extension will allow us to plunge deeper into the shadows, fine-tuning the atmosphere, gameplay mechanics, and bone-chilling surprises that await you.

Mark your calendars for the new release date: 18 August 2023. We understand that the anticipation might be nerve-wracking, but rest assured that this extra time will be well spent to ensure every flicker of candlelight and echoing footstep sends shivers down your spine.

We're tremendously grateful for your patience and continued support. Your commitment to the world of horror fuels our determination to craft an experience that will linger in your nightmares. Stay connected with us as we unveil more insights, sneak peeks, and eerie tales leading up to the new release date.

Should you have any questions or need further information, don't hesitate to reach out to us via hamzatahir672@outlook.com. Your engagement is what gives life to Evil Officer.

Face your fears, for they are your darkest companions on this chilling journey.

Sincerely,

Hamza
Developer
aitcHGames
